query: SELECT COALESCE(game_name, '') AS "game_name!", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "sessions!", COALESCE(AVG(avg_viewers), 0)::float8 AS "avg_v!", COALESCE(MAX(peak_viewers), 0)::bigint AS "peak_v!", COALESCE(AVG(duration_min), 0)::float8 AS "avg_dur!", COALESCE(AVG(follower_delta), 0)::float8 AS "avg_fd!" FROM exp_sessions WHERE LOWER(streamer) = $1 AND started_at >= $2 AND ended_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY game_name ORDER BY COALESCE(AVG(avg_viewers), 0)::float8 DESC
